# Week 4 — Visual QA log

**Source:** `docs/pptx/week-4-advanced.pptx` (38 slides, regenerated by `scripts/build_pptx_week_4.py`)

## Method
1. `soffice --headless --convert-to pdf` → PDF
2. `pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80` → one JPEG per defect/sanity slide
3. Walked the flagged content slides and sampled the cover and the closing "next week" slide for regressions.

## Defects found and fixed in `scripts/build_pptx_week_4.py`
- **`−19pp` rendered as one giant 120 pt number.** Slide 7 sources from `<div class="stat-big">−19<span>pp</span></div>` in `docs/decks/week-4-advanced.html`. The HTML extractor pulled the entire text content as `stat`, so `−19pp` rendered at 120 pt and overflowed the left card. **Fix:** the stat-big extraction now keeps the inner `<span>` text as a separate `stat_suffix`; `_build_stat_split` accepts `stat_suffix` and renders two runs in one paragraph — `−19` at 120 pt + `pp` at 56 pt — preserving the visual hierarchy from the HTML deck.
- **Two-line H1s pushed subheads, timeboxes, and grids into the title.** Slides 24 (2-col, "Backup scenarios — if the room is light on real problems"), 35 (workshop, "Write your playbook — one page, one workflow"), and the quad/quote/bullets layouts all used a fixed title height of 0.85"–1.0" and a `len // …` line estimate, so a 2-line H1 collided with the subhead/timebox/grid below. **Fix:** added `_estimate_visible_lines` (matches the Week 6 pattern with `char_w = 0.62 * pt / 72`); `build_content_two_col`, `build_content_bullets`, `build_workshop`, `_build_quad`, `_build_quote_bullets`, and `_build_bullets_quote` now compute `title_h_in = max(min, line_h * lines + 0.18)` and shift the subhead / timebox / body region down by the resulting height + 0.05".

## Verified after fix
- Slide 1 (cover): unchanged, three meta columns intact.
- Slide 7 ("Why this map is the most valuable thing you'll make today"): left card now reads "−19" at 120 pt with "pp" at 56 pt, source caption clear; right column intact.
- Slide 24 ("Backup scenarios — if the room is light on real problems"): 2-line title sits above the subhead; the four scenario cards form a clean 2×2 grid below.
- Slide 35 ("Write your playbook — one page, one workflow"): 2-line title above the red timebox line; PROMPT and completion-bar boxes clear.
- Slide 38 (Week 5 preview): single-line title and two bullet columns — unchanged, no regression.

## Known minor cosmetic items (logged, not fixed in this pass)
- Slide 7's "pp" suffix at 56 pt is intentionally larger than typical body text so the unit reads at lecture distance; matches the visual weight of the HTML deck.

## How to re-run the QA
```sh
uv run python3 scripts/build_pptx_week_4.py
soffice --headless -env:UserInstallation=file:///tmp/sof-4 \
  --convert-to pdf --outdir /tmp/qa-week4 docs/pptx/week-4-advanced.pptx
pdftoppm -jpeg -r 80 /tmp/qa-week4/week-4-advanced.pdf /tmp/qa-week4/slide
```
